title: Viewer's theory that the stranger was a kachina spirit guide

tellings.quote: "That's a cachina that came to make sure you were on the right path."

plain: A viewer named Vince has a theory about a mysterious stranger that Geoffrey Drumm says he met in Egypt: the stranger was a kachina, a spirit being from the traditions of Native peoples of the American Southwest. Drumm, a researcher who says an alien explained the true purpose of the pyramids to him, repeats the viewer's words: "That's a kachina that came to make sure you were on the right path." If so, the stranger was a guide sent to keep Drumm's work on track.
